fusions.name: Worry the Wound
fusions.desc: A harrying bite that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Coastwide Howl
fusions.desc: Howls down a cone 6 tiles ahead, which deals 26 damage to everything in it. Your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Packmate's Answer
fusions.desc: A packmate answers your call for 15 seconds. It bites an enemy within 5 tiles every 1.5 seconds, which deals 5 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Matriline
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you deal 20% more physical damage for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
